scenes.name: BARE KERNEL
lines: Before any classical library loads, Lean's kernel is bare CIC.
导入任何经典库之前，Lean 的内核是裸 CIC：纯归纳构造演算。
Three building blocks: dependent functions, universes, inductive types. Four rules: beta, delta, iota, zeta.
三种构件：依值函数、宇宙层级、有限归纳定义；四条归约规则：β、δ、ι、ζ。
Three is successor, successor, successor of zero: a finite tree, no infinite bag behind it.
3 就是 succ succ succ zero：一棵有限的树，背后没有装满无穷的口袋。

scenes.name: THREE HIDDEN AXIOMS
lines: Classical axioms enter by shortcuts. Choice pulls out a witness with no recipe.
经典公理借捷径混进来。选择公理凭空抽出元素，却不给算法。
Quotients glue equivalent forms, the classical reals bring in both, and propositional extensionality adds a third.
商公理把等价的表示粘成一个，经典实数把两条都带进来；命题外延性是第三条。
The strict libraries start from a bare prelude: equality is decided by a program that always halts.
严格库从裸 prelude 起步：相等由一个必定停机的程序判定。

scenes.name: ONE OVER M
lines: Precision becomes a contract: epsilon equals one over M.
精度成了一纸契约：ε 等于 1/M，M 是正整数。
At M equals twelve, the reduced fractions form a finite grid.
取 M = 12，既约分数组成一张有限格网。
No gap is smaller than one over one hundred thirty-two, as between one twelfth and one eleventh.
格网里没有哪道间隙小于 1/132，例如 1/12 与 1/11 之间。

scenes.name: RAISE THE HORIZON
lines: Composing can outgrow the horizon: one, two times one, three gives five, five, at height five.
复合会撑破视界：[1 : 2] 乘 [1 : 3] 得 (5, 5)，高度升到 5。
The common factor cancels, landing on one, one.
约去公因子，落回 [1 : 1]。
One, two times two, five gives nine, eight: the horizon rises on demand to nine.

scenes.name: THREE MOTHER LAWS
lines: Remove the privileged origin and the plus sign; the book's model keeps two primitives.
再拆掉特权原点与加号。本书的模型只留下两个原语。
A ternary transport carries the relation of x to a bridge y onto z; a fidelity, kappa, reads alignment.
三元迁移把 x 相对于桥 y 的关系搬到 z 上；保真度 κ 读出两态的对齐程度。
Law one: x, x, z gives z; x, z, z gives x; brackets reassociate.
法则 I：[x, x, z] = z，[x, z, z] = x，括号可以重新结合。
Law two: kappa is symmetric, separating and transport-invariant, with every finite Gram form nonnegative.
法则 II：κ 对称、能分离点、在迁移下不变，每个有限格拉姆二次型都非负。
Law three: some bracket, read backwards, gives a different answer.
法则 III：有的括号倒过来读，结果就变了。

scenes.name: FOR FREE
lines: No pi, no e, no plus, no built-in one; yet bounds come for free.
没有 π、没有 e、没有加号、没有预设的单位元，上界却白白得来。
Weights one and minus one make the Gram form two minus two kappa, at least zero: kappa is at most one.
取权重 1 与 −1，格拉姆二次型成为 2 − 2κ ≥ 0：所以 κ 至多为 1。
Pick any point o as home: x star z is x, o, z; x inverse is o, x, o.
任选一点 o 当作家：x ⋆ z 就是 [x, o, z]，x 的逆元是 [o, x, o]。
Law one makes it a group. Any point can be home; none is privileged.
法则 I 让它成为群。哪一点都可以当家，没有哪一点高人一等。

scenes.name: CLASS, NOT AXIOM
lines: Lean trusts axioms unchecked: declare kappa of x with x is one on raw quadruples, forget the zero quadruple, and zero equals one.
Lean 无条件信任 axiom：在原始四元组上声明 κ(x, x) = 1，漏掉零四元组，就推出 0 = 1。
Now everything is provable. And an axiom cannot compute: reduction stalls.
从此一切命题都能“被证明”。而且 axiom 不能计算：归约卡死。
A class instead bundles the operations with a certificate for each law.
改用类型类：把运算与每条法则的证书收在一起。
It promises only its fields: the quaternion group with constant kappa passes, yet kappa of one and minus one is one.
它只承诺所列字段：取常值 κ 的四元数群全都通过，可 κ(1, −1) 也等于 1。
The rest must be proved, law by law.
其余法则还须在具体载体上逐条补证。

scenes.name: FLOOR
lines: Omega Math, chapter one.
《OMEGA MATH》· 第一章
